$comment: Compatibility sweep round 8 list (compiled by Android compat round 10; no desktop sweep ran for these ranks, the desktop sweep having moved to a per-release cadence after its round 7): the next 30 Chrome Web Store extensions by install count after the top 30 of round 1, the 30 of next30.json, the 30 of next30-round3.json, the 30 of next30-round4.json, the 30 of next30-round5.json, the 30 of next30-round6.json and the 30 of next30-round7.json (ranks 211-240; the Android driver CompatSweep.kt carries these rows; manifests under the project store internal/extensions/next30-round8/). Counts are the store detail pages' rounded figures read 2026-09-22; ties inside one rounded bucket are ordered by the page's rating count, equal rounded rating counts by name. Candidates came from the store's category listings and keyword searches, about 13,260 detail pages probed across rounds 3 to 8 (this round added 202 search terms and 901 new detail pages, none of them at or above the rounded 1,000,000 bucket). Every unmeasured item above the rounded 1,000,000 bucket is organisation-managed or organisation-login-only, so ranks 211-240 are the rounded 1,000,000 bucket's 30 rankable items with the most ratings after round 7's 30: Hotspot Shield entered the bucket since round 7's read (900,000 then), and the cut falls between Co:Writer at 82 ratings and ArkSigner at 62. Three items whose detail pages hide the user count today (Mote, Snap&Read, Co:Writer) are ranked by the round 3 probe's read of 2026-09-20, as round 6 ranked The QR Code Generator. Not ranked: themes (Morpheon Dark), Chrome Apps (Google Classroom), organisation-managed or organisation-login-only items (ClassLink OneClick, Clever, Mobility Print, Endpoint Verification, Lightspeed Insight Agent, Okta Browser Plugin, Trellix Endpoint Security Web Control, LearnPlatform for Students, OpenText Content Server Browser Web Extension, My Apps Secure Sign-in Extension, MasteryConnect LockDown Browser, HID Credential Management Extension, Snow Web Application Metering, iboss Cloud Connector, LanSchool Web Helper, Browser Security Plus, Browser Redirection Extension, ActivID CMS extension) and Google items whose detail pages publish no user count.
